basic_details.job_title: DUK Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Lead Auditor, Cybersecurity Solutions Architect and More Posts
basic_details.total_vacancies: Lead Auditor, Cybersecurity Solutions Architect, Junior Forensics Analyst
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.details: The University invites applications from qualified Indian citizens. Age is counted as of the last date for submission of the application. | Age relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates. | Essential qualification: B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech./MCA/M.Sc. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related discipline from a recognised University/Educational Institution. | Essential experience: | A minimum of 12 years of relevant professional experience in cybersecurity, information security auditing, security assessments or related fields. Demonstrated experience in planning, leading, conducting and reviewing cybersecurity audits and security assessments. Experience in one or more of: Web Application Security Auditing, Mobile Application Security Auditing, IT Infrastructure Security Auditing, Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT), Secure Code Review and information security compliance assessments. Experience in audit methodology development, risk assessment, vulnerability validation, evidence review, audit reporting and recommending corrective actions. Experience in leading technical teams, reviewing audit deliverables, ensuring quality standards and coordinating with clients and stakeholders. | Desirable: | Internationally recognised certifications such as ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor, CISA, CISSP, CISM, CPENT, CEH or equivalent. Multiple relevant certifications will be an advantage. Experience in leading end-to-end audit engagements, from scope definition, planning and resource allocation to execution, quality review and final report submission. Good knowledge of CERT-In directions and guidelines, recognised cybersecurity frameworks, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST frameworks and security auditing standards. Experience in developing standard operating procedures, audit checklists, methodologies, quality assurance processes and report templates. Ability to evaluate security findings, assess risks, determine severity and business impact, and recommend practical remediation. Experience in supervising and mentoring security analysts, auditors and technical specialists. Excellent technical report-writing, presentation, communication, team leadership and client-management skills. An advantage: audit assignments for Government departments, PSUs, universities, autonomous institutions or private-sector organisations, and support for proposals, Statements of Work (SoW), project planning, audit estimates and client consultations. | Essential qualification: B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech./MCA/M.Sc. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related discipline from a recognised University/Educational Institution. | Essential experience: | A minimum of 10 years of relevant professional experience in cybersecurity, networking, system administration, cybersecurity consulting, solution design or related fields. Experience in designing cybersecurity solutions, conducting security assessments, and preparing technical proposals and project reports. Experience in at least some of: VAPT, application security, network and infrastructure security, cloud security, security governance, risk and compliance. Experience in client engagement, requirement analysis, solution presentation and coordination with technical teams. | Desirable: | The same certifications as listed for the Lead Auditor, with multiple relevant certifications an advantage. Good knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including ISO/IEC 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework and applicable CERT-In directions and guidelines. Ability to design and recommend security architectures, cybersecurity solutions, technical controls and implementation roadmaps. Experience in preparing technical proposals, techno-commercial bids, project estimates, SoW, consultancy reports and project documentation. Experience in business development, client relationship management, institutional partnerships and identifying consulting and audit opportunities. Experience with Government departments, PSUs, universities, autonomous institutions or private-sector organisations will be an advantage. Excellent communication, presentation, analytical, coordination and report-writing skills. | Essential qualification: B.E./B.Tech./BCA/MCA/M.Sc. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Digital Forensics or a related discipline from a recognised University/Educational Institution. | Essential experience: Experience is not mandatory, and fresh graduates may apply. Candidates with up to one year of relevant experience in digital forensics, cybersecurity, incident response or related fields will also be considered. The notice also lists these under essential experience: | Basic knowledge of computer systems, operating systems, file systems, storage devices and networking. Basic understanding of digital evidence identification, preservation, acquisition and forensic examination. Familiarity with Windows and Linux operating systems and command-line tools. Ability to document technical procedures, maintain records and prepare clear technical reports. | Desirable: | Certifications or training in digital forensics, incident response, cybersecurity or computer investigations. Familiarity with tools such as Autopsy, The Sleuth Kit, FTK Imager, Magnet AXIOM or equivalent tools. Basic knowledge of disk imaging, file-system analysis, deleted-file recovery, metadata examination, hash verification and timeline analysis. Awareness of chain of custody, evidence integrity, evidence handling procedures and the importance of maintaining forensic working copies. Basic understanding of mobile device forensics, browser artefact analysis, email forensics, log analysis and malware-related investigations. Familiarity with Python, Bash or PowerShell will be an advantage. Good analytical, problem-solving, documentation and communication skills, and willingness to learn new forensic tools, techniques and investigative methodologies. | See the official notification for the full discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

selection_process: Selection will be based on a test and/or interview

held in Thiruvananthapuram district only. The schedule reaches candidates through their registered email only. Any selection or appointment is provisional and subject to physical verification of documents.
how_to_apply: Open the application form on the DUK careers page. The submission guidelines are in the same Recruitment Portal.
Fill in every relevant field. Anything not claimed in the application against the appropriate field will not be considered later, and no deviation from the filled-in data will be entertained.
Upload scanned copies of the documents proving age, qualifications and experience.
Submit the application by the last date.
Check your registered email regularly after the last date for the test or interview schedule.
Keep the original documents ready, as they are to be produced as and when called for.
Applications without the supporting documents will be summarily rejected, with no further chance to submit them.
Late or incomplete applications, and those that do not meet the norms in the notification or the portal's instructions, will be summarily rejected.
A candidate who does not meet the eligibility norms, gives false information or suppresses a material fact will have the candidature cancelled.
Canvassing in any form will entail cancellation of candidature.
No interim queries will be entertained after the application is submitted.
Applications are processed entirely on the information and documents provided, under the self-certification provisions.
The University may cancel the advertisement or the entire selection process at any stage without assigning a reason, and its decision is final.

content_sections.heading: About DUK
content_sections.text: Kerala University of Digital Sciences, Innovation and Technology is the university issuing this notification, and it refers to itself as DUK in the job descriptions. KSAAC is its project for cybersecurity auditing, with services covering audit, consultancy, training and compliance.

content_sections.heading: Job Duties
content_sections.text: Lead and manage KSAAC's cybersecurity auditing engagements, and plan and supervise audits including web and mobile application, IT infrastructure, VAPT and Secure Code Review work. Define audit scope, objectives, methodology, timelines, resources and deliverables, then allocate work and guide the audit team. Review and validate findings, evidence and risk ratings, and oversee draft and final audit reports, executive summaries and risk registers. Maintain liaison with CERT-In, track its notifications and regulatory developments, and recommend updates to audit practices. Develop audit methodologies, procedures, checklists, templates and quality assurance processes. Mentor security auditors and analysts, coordinate with client organisations and support proposals, Statements of Work and project estimates. Identify delivery risks, resolve technical issues and escalate matters needing management intervention. Design secure architectures and solutions for applications, networks, IT infrastructure, cloud environments and enterprise systems. Analyse client requirements and develop technical approaches and implementation roadmaps. Support delivery of services such as VAPT, security audits, secure code review, digital forensics, governance, risk assessment and compliance. Prepare technical proposals, techno-commercial bids, project estimates, service descriptions and consultancy reports. Support business development for KSAAC and DUK, and build relationships with Government departments, PSUs, universities and industries. Take part in client meetings, presentations, negotiations and proposal follow-ups. Track emerging technologies and market requirements, and help develop service catalogues, pricing models and delivery frameworks. Assist senior forensic professionals in investigations involving computers, storage media, mobile devices, logs and other digital sources. Help identify, preserve, acquire and examine digital evidence, and maintain chain-of-custody records. Perform forensic disk imaging, hash verification, file-system analysis, metadata examination and deleted-file recovery under supervision. Assist in analysing system artefacts, browser history, application artefacts and event logs. Assist in preparing examination notes, evidence inventories and draft forensic reports. Support incident response, cybercrime investigations and malware-related examinations where required. Help maintain forensic laboratory equipment, software, evidence storage systems and case documentation, and take part in internal training. Each post also carries any other related duties assigned by the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on a test and/or interview, held in Thiruvananthapuram district only. The schedule reaches candidates through their registered email only. Any selection or appointment is provisional and subject to physical verification of documents.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Each appointment is on contract basis for one year. The term may be extended further based on the performance and project requirements. The job location for all posts is Thiruvananthapuram. If suppression of material facts or incorrect information is detected even after appointment, the service is liable to be terminated.

faq.question: Q1. Can a fresher apply for the Junior Forensics Analyst post?
faq.answer: Yes. Experience is not mandatory for this post, and candidates with up to one year of relevant experience will also be considered.

faq.question: Q2. How much experience does the Lead Auditor post need?
faq.answer: A minimum of 12 years of relevant professional experience is needed, in fields such as cybersecurity, information security auditing or security assessments.

faq.question: Q3. Is BCA accepted for all three posts?
faq.answer: No. BCA is listed only for the Junior Forensics Analyst post. The other two posts list B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech./MCA/M.Sc.

faq.question: Q4. Are certifications compulsory for the senior posts?
faq.answer: No. Certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CISM and CEH appear under the desirable skillset, not the essential requirements.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit after relaxation?
faq.answer: The 40-year limit becomes 45 for SC/ST and 43 for OBC candidates. The 30-year limit becomes 35 for SC/ST and 33 for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is on contract for one year, and an extension may follow based on performance and project requirements.

faq.question: Q7. How will I know the test or interview date?
faq.answer: The schedule is sent only to your registered email, so that inbox needs checking after the application deadline.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents must be uploaded?
faq.answer: Upload scanned copies of the documents proving age, qualifications and experience. An application without them is summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the test or interview take place?
faq.answer: It will be conducted in Thiruvananthapuram district only, which is also the job location for all three posts.
